title: Notebooks nav link must gate on notebooks:read, not dashboards:read
answers: Notebooks nav item shows for users who shouldn't have notebook access
Why does the Notebooks nav link check dashboard permissions?
Notebooks RBAC not fully enforced on the nav/sidebar
body:
Symptom: Notebooks top-level nav link appeared/disappeared based on the user's dashboard read permission instead of their notebook permission.
Root cause: buildNotebooksNavLink in pkg/services/navtree/navtreeimpl/navtree.go checked ac.EvalPermission(dashboards.ActionDashboardsRead), a leftover from when Notebooks reused dashboard RBAC actions (the frontend nav entry was already fixed in #132699).
Fix pattern: Gate on ac.EvalPermission(notebooks.ActionNotebooksRead) from pkg/services/notebooks instead of any dashboards.Action*. Apiserver-side filtering of the actual notebook list is separate and still applies.
Constraints: Applies to any backend or frontend gating of Notebooks UI/API surfaces - always use the notebooks RBAC action set, not dashboards actions, even though Notebooks historically borrowed dashboard permissions.
applies: Any code gating visibility/access to Notebooks features (nav links, API handlers) in grafana core
